item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 日本語名: PrettyDevilパラダイス～ミリオム魔界奪還指令！～
  • 英語名: Pretty Devil Paradise Millium Makai Dakkan Shirei!

あらすじ

Millium is a probationary devil, who suddenly fell from the sky. Sota, the main character, and Millium has been peacefully living together since then. One day, a new student joins his class and a pretty girl moves to the next door. As a matter of fact, these two girls are succubi and their mission is to bring Millium back to their world. Well, will Sota be able to keep his lovelove life with Millium…?

item.title: Kyou kara Prince
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Vitamin
  • 発売日: 2008-11-28
  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今日からプリンス
  • 英語名: Kyou kara Prince

あらすじ

The main character lives in a poor area. He is called the black prince because he resembles the prince of the Supple Kingdom. One day, he is abducted by someone from the Nordia Kingdom. They disguise him as the prince of the Supple Kingdom and send him to the castle of the Supple Kingdom while the king, the queen, and the prince are away. However, the prince comes back to the castle earlier than they expected while the protagonist is also there. After a serious crisis, he successfully manages to exile the real prince…. He enjoys his life there, but he hears the king and the queen are coming back in three weeks. He decides to conciliate three princesses to his side to get through his difficult situation. Like this, he pretends he is the real prince and approaches them….

Sin, the prince of the Supple Kingdom, and Janne are invited to a ceremony taken place in the Granju Kingdom. The ceremony finishes with no problems and they enjoy their time there for a while. Kasumi asks Sin and Janne to help her and they accept it. According to Kasumi, what she looks for is somewhere around the town….
